meta.title: 不结婚不生子的两个准备：经济实力是底气
meta.title_en: Two Preparations for Choosing a Child-Free Life

scenes.context: 讲者指出不婚不育的第一个准备是应对外界催婚与内心孤单的双重压力。
sentences: 如果你选择了不结婚不生子，要做好两个准备。
If you choose a child-free, marriage-free life, there are two things you need to prepare for.
做好准备：prepare for
中国还是传统社会，它会有各种催婚，有各种或明或暗的压力会加到身上。
China is still a traditional society, with all kinds of nagging about marriage and pressure, open or subtle, piling on you.
催婚：pressure to get married
当你有个头疼脑热、比较衰弱的时候，身边没有至亲的人陪伴。
When you're sick or feeling weak, there's no one close by your side.
头疼脑热：when you're under the weather
paraphrase: 外界催婚+内心孤单=双份压力
Outside nagging plus inner loneliness is a double load.
压力随时间增加→要提前想清楚
The pressure grows with age, so think it through early.
scenes.speak: If you choose a child-free, marriage-free life, there are two things you need to prepare for. China is still a traditional society, with all kinds of nagging about marriage and pressure, open or subtle, piling on you. When you're sick or feeling weak, there's no one close by your side.

scenes.title_cn: 内心的孤单与后悔风险
scenes.title_en: Inner loneliness and the risk of regret
scenes.context: 讲者提醒五十多岁再后悔就迟了，指出父母年迈时自己需要接受无人照顾的现实。
sentences: 生病了父母要么不在了要么年纪很大了，他们没有办法来照顾你。
When you're ill, your parents may be gone or too old to take care of you.
年纪很大：getting on in years
这个时候你是不是能够接受自己的内心？
At that point, can you truly accept it in your own heart?
接受内心：make peace with it
如果你到了五十多岁再后悔，就迟了，这世界上是没有后悔药的。
If you only regret it in your fifties, it's too late — there's no undo button in life.
后悔药：an undo button / no second chance
paraphrase: 父母无法照顾→要提前接受
When parents can't help, acceptance must come early.
后悔有截止日期→五十岁再想就晚了
Regret has a deadline; by your fifties it's too late.
scenes.speak: When you're ill, your parents may be gone or too old to take care of you. At that point, can you truly accept it in your own heart? If you only regret it in your fifties, it's too late — there's no undo button in life.

scenes.title_en: Financial strength is the real backing
scenes.context: 讲者点出婚姻是经济合伙人制，不婚不育要提前储备四类能力。
sentences: 本质上婚姻也是一种经济的合伙人制，比一个人抗风险能力会大。
In essence, marriage is a form of economic partnership, which cushions risk far better than going solo.
经济合伙人：an economic partnership
如果不结婚不生子，你未来的抗风险能力是比较低的。
Without marriage or kids, your ability to absorb risk is lower.
抗风险能力：ability to absorb risk
要提前预备你的专业能力、职场能力、赚钱能力以及调动资源的能力。
You need to build up your professional skills, career capability, earning power, and ability to mobilize resources.
调动资源：mobilize resources
paraphrase: 婚姻=经济合伙人→抗风险更强
Marriage is a partnership that spreads risk.
不婚不育→用四类能力补齐
Go solo? Compensate with four kinds of capability.
scenes.speak: In essence, marriage is a form of economic partnership, which cushions risk far better than going solo. Without marriage or kids, your ability to absorb risk is lower. You need to build up your professional skills, career capability, earning power, and ability to mobilize resources.

practice: If you go child-free, prepare for two things.
There's no one close by when you're under the weather.
Marriage is an economic partnership that spreads risk.
I need to build my earning power and ability to mobilize resources.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：There is no medicine for regret in this world.
✓ 地道说法：There's no undo button in life.
undo button 是「后悔药」的常用口语说法。
✕ 直译腔：My anti-risk ability is low.
✓ 地道说法：My ability to absorb risk is lower.
absorb risk 比 anti-risk ability 地道。
✕ 直译腔：Marriage is an economic partner system.
✓ 地道说法：Marriage is a form of economic partnership.
partnership 表达合伙人制更自然。
✕ 直译腔：When I have a headache and fever.
✓ 地道说法：When I'm under the weather.
under the weather 是「身体不适」的固定表达。
shifts: 不婚不育=自己想通就行
不婚不育=压力与实力的双重准备
婚姻只谈感情不谈经济
婚姻本质是经济合伙人制
年轻时就把能力储备到位
footer_notes: ASR 校正说明：「自亲的人」校正为「至亲的人」，「接近照顾」校正为「来接（近）照顾」，「就辞了」校正为「就迟了」，「经济的合伙人质」校正为「经济合伙人制」，「预备」按语境保留，「那不行」保留原意。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
